exercises.title: PE SP26 Block 3 — Employee master-detail + Plant Shop (JSON Server CRUD)
exercises.problemHtml:
PRACTICAL EXAMINATION

FER202 · SPRING 2026 Block 3 PE (same paper as the Exam Room's PE4). Duration: 85 minutes. In the exam each question is its own React project; in Code Lab both live in one app: Question 1 at /employees, Question 2 at /plants and /orders.

Question 1: Display Object Data using React Bootstrap (4 marks)

File: src/data/employees.js (given)

export const employees = [
  { id: 1, fullName: "Vo An Hai", position: "Frontend Developer", department: "Software Engineering", salary: 1200, status: "Active" },
  { id: 2, fullName: "Le Hong Manh", position: "Backend Developer", department: "Software Engineering", salary: 1800, status: "Active" },
  { id: 3, fullName: "Nguyen Van Ty", position: "Tester", department: "Quality Assurance", salary: 1200, status: "Inactive" },
];

1.1. Display employee list using React Bootstrap (2 marks)

  • Show all employees using React Bootstrap components (Table, Card, Container, Row, Col, Button, Badge…).
  • Columns: ID | Full Name | Position | Department | Salary | Status | Action; salary as $1200; each row has a [View Detail] button.
  • The Employee List and the Employee Detail area are side by side; before any selection the detail area shows Please select an employee.

1.2. Display employee detail area (1.5 marks)

  • When an employee item (row) or the View Detail button is clicked, the selected employee's information is shown in a separate area: ID, Full Name, Position, Department, Salary, Status.

1.3. Apply Bootstrap styling properly (0.5 mark)

  • The interface must be clear and aligned, with React Bootstrap used appropriately.

Question 2: Plant Shop Management using JSON Server (6 marks)

Build a React application that manages a plant trading system with 2 objects: plants and orders. Use React Router to split it into at least two pages, Plant Management and Order Management, with a menu/navigation bar between them. File: src/data/db.json; API BASE URL: http://localhost:9999.

{
  "plants": [
    { "id": 1, "name": "Monstera", "price": 500, "category": "Indoor", "stock": 10 },
    { "id": 2, "name": "Cactus", "price": 200, "category": "Outdoor", "stock": 20 },
    { "id": 3, "name": "Bonsai", "price": 1000, "category": "Decor", "stock": 5 }
  ],
  "orders": [
    { "id": 1, "customerName": "Vo An Hai", "plantId": 1, "quantity": 2 },
    { "id": 2, "customerName": "Le Hong Manh", "plantId": 2, "quantity": 1 }
  ]
}

2.1. Display plant list

  • Fetch data from API /plants; columns ID, Name, Price, Category, Stock, Actions ([Edit] [Delete]).

2.2. Full CRUD for Plants

  • Create plant, Update plant, Delete plant; the UI must update correctly. Add Plant form: Name · Price · Category · Stock · [Add Plant]. After deleting show Plant deleted successfully.

2.3. Manage Orders

  • List orders: customerName, plant name (mapping from plantId), quantity; Create order; Delete order. Add Order form: Customer Name · Plant (-- Select Plant --) · Quantity · [Add Order].

2.4. Validation

Plant fieldRuleMessage
nameRequiredName is required.
price> 0Price must be greater than 0.
categoryRequiredCategory is required.
stock≥ 0Stock must be greater than or equal to 0.
Order fieldRuleMessage
customerNameRequiredCustomer name is required.
plantIdRequiredPlease select a plant.
quantity> 0Quantity must be greater than 0.

Bonus (not auto-graded): useContext / Redux Toolkit; reduce plant stock when creating an order; prevent ordering when quantity > stock; total price of each order.

Code Lab — auto-grader notes (not part of the paper)

Validation messages are searched anywhere on the page (inline feedback, Alert or text) — but they must be VISIBLE after pressing the submit button, so do not disable the button while the form is invalid.

Element ids / classes used by the auto-grader

SelectorPurpose
#employee-table · .employee-row · #employee-row-<id> · .view-detailQ1 — the table, one row per employee (id = employee-row- + id), the View Detail button
#employee-detail · .detail-placeholderQ1 — the detail area after a selection; the "Please select an employee." element
nav a[href="/plants"] · nav a[href="/orders"]Q2 — navbar links (Link/NavLink inside <nav>)
.plant-row · #plant-row-<id> · .edit-btn · .delete-btnone row per plant; its Edit and Delete buttons
#plant-name · #plant-price · #plant-category · #plant-stock · #plant-submitthe Add/Update Plant form (Edit loads the plant into the same form)
#order-table · .order-row · #order-row-<id> · .order-deletethe orders table, one row per order, its Delete button
#order-customer · #order-plant · #order-quantity · #order-submitthe Add Order form (option value = plant id)

Auto-grader rubric (10 points, Run = sample checks · Submit = full rubric incl. hidden)

#Rubric lineMarks
1Q1 · Employee list with React Bootstrap2
2Q1 · Employee detail area (row or View Detail) + layout2
3Q2 · React Router pages + plant list1.5
4Q2 · Full CRUD for plants2
5Q2 · Orders: mapping, create, delete1.5
6Q2 · Validation messages (plants + orders)1

Requirements

  • JSON Server as in the exam: npx json-server --watch src/data/db.json --port 9999 (the grader serves the same data).
  • The starter has src/index.js, an empty src/App.js and the given src/data/employees.js.
  • Press Run for the sample checks, Submit for the full rubric (hidden checks included). Time yourself: 85 minutes.

BÀI THI THỰC HÀNH

FER202 · PE SPRING 2026 Block 3 (cùng đề PE4 ở Phòng thi). Thời gian: 85 phút. Lúc thi mỗi câu một project; Code Lab gộp một app: Câu 1 ở /employees, Câu 2 ở /plants và /orders.

Câu 1: Hiển thị dữ liệu object bằng React Bootstrap (4 điểm)

File: src/data/employees.js (cho sẵn)

export const employees = [
  { id: 1, fullName: "Vo An Hai", position: "Frontend Developer", department: "Software Engineering", salary: 1200, status: "Active" },
  { id: 2, fullName: "Le Hong Manh", position: "Backend Developer", department: "Software Engineering", salary: 1800, status: "Active" },
  { id: 3, fullName: "Nguyen Van Ty", position: "Tester", department: "Quality Assurance", salary: 1200, status: "Inactive" },
];
  • 1.1 (2đ) Hiện mọi nhân viên bằng component React Bootstrap; cột ID | Full Name | Position | Department | Salary | Status | Action; lương dạng $1200; mỗi dòng có nút [View Detail]. Danh sách và vùng Employee Detail đặt cạnh nhau; chưa chọn ai thì vùng chi tiết hiện Please select an employee.
  • 1.2 (1,5đ) Bấm dòng hoặc nút View Detail ⇒ thông tin người đó (ID, Full Name, Position, Department, Salary, Status) hiện ở vùng riêng.
  • 1.3 (0,5đ) Giao diện rõ ràng, thẳng hàng, dùng React Bootstrap hợp lý.

Câu 2: Quản lý cửa hàng cây dùng JSON Server (6 điểm)

App React quản lý plants và orders; React Router chia ít nhất 2 trang Plant Management và Order Management, có navbar. File src/data/db.json; API BASE URL http://localhost:9999.

{
  "plants": [
    { "id": 1, "name": "Monstera", "price": 500, "category": "Indoor", "stock": 10 },
    { "id": 2, "name": "Cactus", "price": 200, "category": "Outdoor", "stock": 20 },
    { "id": 3, "name": "Bonsai", "price": 1000, "category": "Decor", "stock": 5 }
  ],
  "orders": [
    { "id": 1, "customerName": "Vo An Hai", "plantId": 1, "quantity": 2 },
    { "id": 2, "customerName": "Le Hong Manh", "plantId": 2, "quantity": 1 }
  ]
}
  • 2.1 Lấy /plants, cột ID, Name, Price, Category, Stock, Actions ([Edit] [Delete]).
  • 2.2 Thêm, sửa, xoá cây; giao diện cập nhật đúng. Form Add Plant: Name · Price · Category · Stock · [Add Plant]. Xoá xong hiện Plant deleted successfully.
  • 2.3 Danh sách đơn: customerName, tên cây (ánh xạ từ plantId), quantity; thêm đơn; xoá đơn. Form Add Order: Customer Name · Plant (-- Select Plant --) · Quantity · [Add Order].
  • 2.4 Kiểm hợp lệ với đúng nguyên văn thông báo: Plant — "Name is required.", "Price must be greater than 0.", "Category is required.", "Stock must be greater than or equal to 0."; Order — "Customer name is required.", "Please select a plant.", "Quantity must be greater than 0.". Dữ liệu sai không được gửi đi.

Điểm thưởng (máy không chấm): useContext / Redux Toolkit; trừ tồn kho khi đặt đơn; chặn quantity > stock; tổng tiền mỗi đơn.

Code Lab — ghi chú cho máy chấm (KHÔNG thuộc tờ đề)

Thông báo lỗi được tìm ở bất kỳ đâu trên trang (feedback dưới ô, Alert hay chữ thường) — nhưng phải HIỆN sau khi bấm nút gửi, nên đừng khoá nút khi form sai.

id / class máy chấm dùng

#employee-detail · .detail-placeholderCâu 1 — vùng chi tiết khi đã chọn; phần tử "Please select an employee."
nav a[href="/plants"] · nav a[href="/orders"]Câu 2 — link navbar (Link/NavLink trong <nav>)

#plant-name · #plant-price · #plant-category · #plant-stock · #plant-submitform Add/Update Plant (Edit nạp cây vào cùng form)
#order-table · .order-row · #order-row-<id> · .order-deletebảng đơn, mỗi đơn một dòng, nút Delete

Thang điểm máy chấm (10 điểm, Chạy thử = kiểm mẫu · Nộp = chấm đủ, có kiểm ẩn)

#Dòng điểmĐiểm

5C2 · Đơn hàng: ánh xạ tên cây, thêm, xoá1.5

Yêu cầu

  • JSON Server như lúc thi: npx json-server --watch src/data/db.json --port 9999 (máy chấm phục vụ đúng dữ liệu đó).
  • Starter có src/index.js, src/App.js trống và src/data/employees.js được phát.
  • Bấm Chạy thử để chạy kiểm mẫu, Nộp để chấm đủ (có kiểm ẩn). Tự bấm giờ: 85 phút.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Question 1 keeps one piece of state, the selected employee; both the row and the button set it, and the right column renders either a Card with labelled fields or the placeholder. Question 2 splits the app with React Router; each page loads from json-server and re-fetches after every POST/PUT/DELETE so the UI mirrors the server. Validation runs on submit and returns an object of messages, shown with React-Bootstrap isInvalid + Form.Control.Feedback. Orders keep only plantId; the table looks up the plant name.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Câu 1 giữ một state duy nhất là nhân viên đang chọn; cả dòng lẫn nút đều gán nó, cột phải hiện Card có nhãn từng trường hoặc dòng chữ chờ. Câu 2 chia trang bằng React Router; mỗi trang tải từ json-server và tải lại sau mỗi POST/PUT/DELETE để giao diện khớp server. Kiểm hợp lệ chạy khi gửi, trả về object thông báo, hiện bằng isInvalid + Form.Control.Feedback. Đơn chỉ lưu plantId; bảng tra ra tên cây.
